_comment: Composite indexes for the Runway API, SCRUM-103 (IIE, 2026).
Firestore indexes single fields automatically, but a query that filters on
one field and orders by another needs the combination declared in advance,
otherwise it fails at run time with FAILED_PRECONDITION (Google, 2026).
Each definition was confirmed against the index Firestore actually asked for
at run time, not guessed from the query - every equality filter in the query
has to appear in the index, including the soft-delete flag.
If 'firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes' rejects this file, delete every
